steps.action: Block outbound traffic to exfiltration destination
steps.description: Immediately stop ongoing data transfer to the attacker-controlled server.

steps.action: Rate-limit outbound Internet traffic as a precaution
steps.command: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root tbf rate 1mbit burst 32kbit latency 400ms
steps.description: Throttle outbound traffic to prevent any remaining exfiltration channels.
Identify which process is responsible for the data transfer.
Quantify how much data has been transferred to the external destination.

steps.action: Identify files accessed by exfiltrating process
steps.description: Determine what data was accessed and may have been exfiltrated.
Gather threat intelligence on the exfiltration destination IP.
Terminate the process responsible for data exfiltration.

steps.action: Add exfiltration destination to firewall blocklist
steps.description: Permanently block this destination and save the firewall rule.

steps.action: Notify data protection officer — potential data breach
steps.command: echo 'DATA BREACH ALERT: T1048.003 | dst={dst_ip} | bytes={bytes_transferred} | time={timestamp}' >> /var/log/intelli-soc/incidents.log
steps.description: Formal breach notification per IR policy. Include data classification and volume.
